preconditions.description: The length of the sequence is between 2 and 200,000.
Each element in the sequence is a positive integer.

postconditions.expression: output[i] == -1 if x <= 0 or x > n at any point for the sequence i, a2, a3, ..., an else output[i] == y at the point of termination
postconditions.description: For each i, the output is the final value of y if the program terminates or -1 if it does not terminate.
